# DiffLens

DiffLens is a local-first online text diff tool for structured developer text.

Website: https://www.difflens.io/
GitHub: https://github.com/difflens-io/difflens

Key capabilities:
- Compare JSON, JSONL, NDJSON, YAML, TOML, XML, HTML, Markdown, cURL, HTTP Request, CSV, TSV, Cookie, Set-Cookie, Java Properties, and plain text.
- Highlight field-level differences for structured formats.
- Highlight inline value fragments when values partially differ.
- Compare content in the browser without uploading user comparison text.
- Support editor line numbers, folding, diff-only view, synchronized scrolling, and adjustable panes.

Useful entry pages:
- JSON diff: https://www.difflens.io/json-diff/
- JSONL diff: https://www.difflens.io/jsonl-diff/
- cURL diff: https://www.difflens.io/curl-diff/
- Cookie diff: https://www.difflens.io/cookie-diff/
- HTTP Request diff: https://www.difflens.io/http-request-diff/
- TOML diff: https://www.difflens.io/toml-diff/
- Markdown diff: https://www.difflens.io/markdown-diff/
